title: Classroom-Based Action Research Proposal (TS1, TS8)
journeyNote: This research began with something I noticed in the classroom, not something I read in a book.
researchTitle: The Effectiveness of a "Praise and Token" System in Reducing Minor Disruptive Behaviors Among Grade 10 Students in President Diosdado Macapagal High School

howOurResearchBegan.heading: How our research began.
howOurResearchBegan.text: Students demonstrated a short attention span, lack of focus, and there were no definite consequences for disruptive behaviors. Together with my groupmates Brix and Aliah, I turned that observation into a research question.

theStudyInPlainLanguage.heading: The study in plain language.
theStudyInPlainLanguage.text: We wanted to find out how effectively minor disruptive behaviors could be reduced by implementing a Token Economy and Behavior-Specific Praise system among Grade 10 students.

deliverables.title: TS1: Action Research Data Bank
deliverables.description: Initial literature review scan, classroom behavioral identification matrix, and intervention data repository.

deliverables.title: Panel Rubric Score & Manuscript Compilation
deliverables.description: Official panel proposal defense evaluation rubric scoring, panel critique feedback, and complete compiled manuscript.

deliverables.title: CBAR Manuscript Only
deliverables.description: Full formal action research proposal across Chapters 1 to 3 detailing behavioral methodologies and token economy systems.
